About Me

Education, technical experience, and engineering interests.

Background & Interests

I’m Drew, a mechanical engineering student at the University of Colorado Boulder, pursuing a minor in physics and expecting to graduate in May 2029. My interests include mechanical design, automotive engineering, aerospace, and clean energy.

Through coursework and projects, I’ve gained experience in CAD, reverse engineering, and fabrication. For my Nitecore work light project, I disassembled the product, measured its components, and recreated the assembly in SOLIDWORKS. Some measured dimensions caused parts to interfere in the assembly, so I had to recheck them and adjust the model.

My Eagle Scout project involved planning and leading the construction of a shed structure and an accessible sink at Animal Assisted Happiness. As the farm’s needs changed, I revised the plans and organized volunteers around the work available each day. The project gave me experience with construction, budgeting, and leading other people through a build.

I’m also involved in CU Autonomous Racing, where I’m working on steering-system design and the master CAD assembly. As the project develops, I plan to contribute additional components and mounting designs.

As a lead instructor at Camp Galileo, I guided campers through STEM projects and helped them identify problems with their designs. I also taught counselors in training leadership and instructional skills.
